purpose: Independent practice of D2.2 dice mode.
student_learning_goal: I can predict the mode of dice rolls.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can predict the mode of dice rolls.
header.character_watermark: Mae with dice in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Roll a die 12 times. Tally each result. Find the MODE.
parts.visual_layout: Tally chart 1-6 with totals + mode line.

image_placeholders.description: A tally chart for dice rolls, Grade 2 worksheet. Header: 'Roll #1 — 12 rolls'. 6 rows labelled 1-6 with tally area and total box. Below: 'Mode: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P1_TALLY at Part 1: keywords name the visual elements.

parts.answer_key: Any tallies for 12 rolls + valid mode (highest tally).

parts.student_instructions: Roll AGAIN 12 times. Find the new mode. Compare to first.

image_placeholders.description: A second tally chart for Grade 2 worksheet. Header: 'Roll #2 — 12 rolls'. 6 rows labelled 1-6. Below: 'Mode: ___' and a comparison line: 'Was the mode the same as Roll #1?'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P2_COMPARE at Part 2: keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Tallies for 12 rolls + mode + comparison answer.

parts.student_instructions: PREDICT the mode of a 3rd 12-roll. Test it.
parts.visual_layout: Prediction line + tally chart + result line.

image_placeholders.description: A prediction layout for Grade 2 worksheet. Top: 'I predict the mode will be: ___'. Middle: tally chart for Roll #3. Bottom: 'Actual mode: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P3_PREDICT at Part 3: keywords name the activity.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, predict what 100 rolls would show.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Use Part 2 for formative — recognizing mode changes between trials.
